scenario: Named-capture name mismatch per LREG.3.3 — the compiler must reject a `(?<name>...)` capture whose name does not match the binding-form name at the same position. Pin: `where (code) = s ~ /(?<device>\w+)/` has named capture `device` at position 0 but binding name `code` at position 0 — rejects with DS_VALIDATE_REGEX_NAME_MISMATCH. Path: `dsc.validate.lreg_4_1_where_capture` then `lreg_3_3_names`, over the `where` capture form ([LREG.4.1]).
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where (code) = e.msg ~ /(?<device>\w+)/
->
    log info "got: {code}"
